fields.headline: Imperium: Legions
fields.subheadline: From a single cohort to the eternal city. Command Rome's legions across a campaign that spans the Republic to the Empire — march, besiege and intrigue your way to a throne history won't forget.
fields.summary: Real-time battles of thousands, a Senate that schemes behind your back, and city-building that turns marble quarries into wonders. Cross-play campaigns for up to eight consuls.
